result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For most small support teams, **Freshdesk is my top recommendation**\. It offers a good balance of affordability, ticket management, automation and room to grow without the complexity of enterprise software.

However, the best choice depends on whether your team primarily handles email, live chat, phone calls or multiple channels.

## My top 5 help desk platforms

**1\. Freshdesk** (Best overall)

Freshworks

- Excellent ticket management and automation.
- Shared inbox, knowledge base and reporting.
- Good balance of features and price.
- Suitable for teams expecting to grow.

**Indicative pricing\:** From \$19/agent/month (annual billing).

[Freshdesk website and plans](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

Email-first customer support

- Very easy for a small team to learn.
- Excellent shared email inbox.
- Internal notes and team collaboration.
- Customer-friendly interface.

**Indicative pricing\:** Free plan for up to 5 users; paid from \$25/user/month annually.

[Help Scout website and plans](https://www.helpscout.com/)

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

Affordable ticketing

- Good ticket automation.
- Customisable workflows.
- Useful reporting and analytics.
- Particularly good if you already use Zoho CRM.

**Indicative pricing\:** Free for up to 3 agents; paid entry plans from around \$7/user/month annually.

[Zoho Desk website and plans](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![CXPA Global | CX Day](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Df7ZME9U6OBHF5y7Iy8re15rfxWfkij2J5upWOY6h17xPwPTHy9GzGMO1pjPycv2eahYGXuZJQqpk7Eu-n45330bnP145JuZvq23mLa9ySgQfmrjrLanGhUx6oyklDReusakKYD0C0EVNYz4WHwYHTEn8t4EiNn2pI71GHk_6Pu88F0xspYAogvoagE-Nhjq?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

Best for advanced support operations

- Powerful ticket routing and automation.
- Extensive integrations.
- Strong reporting capabilities.
- Good for more complex support operations.

**Indicative pricing\:** From \$19/agent/month for basic support; broader Suite functionality costs more.

[Zendesk website and plans](https://www.zendesk.co.uk/)

Best for live chat and AI support

- Excellent website live chat.
- AI customer support automation.
- In-app messaging.
- Good for SaaS and digital businesses.

## Quick comparison

| Software | Ease of use | Best feature |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Freshdesk | Very good | Ticket management |
| Help Scout | Excellent | Shared inbox |
| Zoho Desk | Good | Affordability |
| Zendesk | Moderate | Advanced workflows |
| Intercom | Very good | Live chat and AI |


## What I'd recommend

For a small support team of around 3–10 people\:

- **Freshdesk\:** If you need a proper ticketing system with automation and reporting.
- **Help Scout\:** If you mainly respond to customer emails and want something straightforward.
- **Zoho Desk\:** If keeping costs low is your biggest priority.
